alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. A small amber block figure with white eyes strides to the right with growing confidence, stretching a little taller and pulsing with chimes that rise in pitch. In the last second the text changes from: me knowing exactly where I'm going, to: recalculating. The figure's eyes go wide, it trembles, then turns and walks back to the left. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
